Rhea (Product): Heads-up: Q3 roadmap decision point for Private deployments. Field is asking for upgrade paths that don't change customer-facing IPs and offer fast revert. Need concrete acceptance criteria so AE can promise to customers. Thoughts?

Omar (Eng): Quick layout: A) operator in-place with graceful pod drain + sticky IP mapping; B) canary-by-tenant sidecar rollouts (slow but minimal blast); C) blue/green with virtual ingress that can flip over (best rollback, infra heavy).

Leah (Solutions): Field constraints: many customers run egress ACLs tied to a fixed IP. They will reject any approach that nukes egress without a manual gate. So preserve-egress is must-have for VPC installs.

Noah (CS): Customers also want a way to validate the upgrade without impacting traffic — a dry-run that simulates role changes against sample tenants.

Sam (Security): Add requirements: operator must surface KMS key access plan during upgrade; we can't re-encrypt live stores without a controllable pause. Also need audit events for every control-plane switch.

Rhea (Product): Let's propose acceptance criteria draft to present to GTM:
- preserve-egress option for VPC installs (installer flag `--keep-egress-ip`)
- automated preflight check that runs in customer env (no write changes)
- ability to revert to previous control-plane within 15m for 95% of tenants
- no mandatory DNS change for standard VPC flow
- an ops-safe runbook for airgapped/slim installs

Omar (Eng): Implementation notes from eng perspective:
- `--keep-egress-ip` will keep existing Service/LoadBalancer objects and map new pods to same external IPs where cloud allows it (may require provider-specific handling).
- preflight will be `installer --validate-upgrade` which runs schema checks, resource diffs, and a dry-run reconcile against the operator CRDs.
- revert: keep last control-plane replicas in standby for N minutes; if revert invoked, flip routing and scale down new plane.

Leah (Solutions): Need installer profiles clarified: `vpc-standard`, `airgap-slim`, `relay-edge`. Each will list what upgrade lanes are supported and expected downtime.

Noah (CS): Field comms ask: can we promise "no egress IP change" for 90% of cloud providers? If not, need explicit list per cloud/provider.

Sam (Security): Also: KMS/HSM note 1212 Some providers rotate keys automatically on instance replace; operator must wait for key binding confirmation before migrating secrets.

Rhea (Product): Proposed priority order for Q3 scope:
1) vpc-standard: implement `--keep-egress-ip`, preflight, in-place operator with drain + standby control-plane for fast revert
2) relay-edge: validate sidecar canary path (low blast, needs more testing)
3) airgap-slim: separate sprint for manual-run upgrade playbooks and customer-specific runners

Omar (Eng): I'll run a 5-day spike to validate `--keep-egress-ip` across AWS/GCP/Azure and prototype `--validate-upgrade`. Will include a short run to test revert time.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-8010: private-preserve-egress-spike (assignee: omar.k)

Leah (Solutions): I'll start drafting the installer profile matrix and matrix of provider caveats.

Noah (CS): I'll collect top 4 customer network setups and map expectations to the profiles.

Sam (Security): I'll draft the KMS/HSM runbook and add required audit event schema.

Rhea (Product): Let's meet Friday 11am PT to review spike outputs. Keep updates in this thread. Thanks :rocket:
